<translate>
<!--T:2-->
The '''Android Saga''' is the fourth saga of the [[Special:MyLanguage/Sagas|story mode]]. It opens once you complete every quest of the [[Special:MyLanguage/Frieza Saga|Frieza Saga]] and takes place on [[Special:MyLanguage/Earth|Earth]]: Mecha Frieza and King Cold, Future Trunks' warning, Goku's heart virus, Dr. Gero's lab, the Androids and Cell, and the Cell Games.
</translate>

<translate>
<!--T:3-->
Completing every quest of the Android Saga opens both the [[Special:MyLanguage/Future Saga|Future Saga]] and the [[Special:MyLanguage/Buu Saga|Buu Saga]]. You can play them in any order.
</translate>

</translate>

<translate>
== Notes == <!--T:87-->
</translate>
<translate>
<!--T:88-->
* The two Shadow Dummy quests are training periods: ''Three Years of Preparation'' opens 15 real-time minutes after it becomes available, and ''Beyond Super Saiyan'' 10 minutes after.
* Several quests send you to [[Special:MyLanguage/Masters|masters]]: [[Special:MyLanguage/Trunks|Trunks]] (quest 3) and [[Special:MyLanguage/Goku|Goku]] (quest 17).
* [[Special:MyLanguage/Cell|Cell]] also hosts the [[Special:MyLanguage/Cell Games|Cell Games]] tournament.
* Several Movies Saga quests (the Androids 13, 14 and 15, Broly and Bojack) open after quests 6, 11, 13 and 15 of this saga.
</translate>
